headline: US hostility unchanged by midterms
dek: Khamenei warned that if US aggressions are repeated, Iran's response 'will take on much broader dimensions', praising Hormuz control and strikes on US bases as retaliation; he said anyone hoping US hostility changes through party/faction shifts or concessions is 'gravely mistaken', and that the US…
sources: Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei's Nov 4 written message, via Al Jazeera liveblog; carried by Reuters, NDTV, Shafaq, News18, Times Now
fault_line: Deterrence or bluff? Tehran reads the midterms as a leash on Trump; critics read the 'broader dimensions' warning as rhetoric while the US blockade and Qeshm strikes continue.

sections.what_happened: Khamenei warned that if US aggressions are repeated, Iran's response 'will take on much broader dimensions', praising Hormuz control and strikes on US bases as retaliation; he said anyone hoping US hostility changes through party/faction shifts or concessions is 'gravely mistaken', and that the US seeks Iran's unconditional surrender. He called 'an ever-stronger Iran' the path to 'absolute deterrence'.
sections.what_verified: AJ liveblog (11:05 + 11:10 GMT entries) + Reuters wire item + NDTV/T3 carry; Shafaq/News18/Times Now carries have NO declared tier in the registry and do not count
sections.what_disputed: No US, Israeli or Gulf-state reaction to this specific message was reported in the material checked; the message announces no new strike, target or date — it is a deterrence warning, not evidence of an imminent Iranian attack. US officials previously described the Qeshm strikes as limited with 'no immediate plans to escalate' (NYT via Rudaw, Nov 3-4).
sections.why_matters: LEAD Short: 'Khamenei's Nov 4 warning — after losing Congress, Trump faces a wider war if he strikes again.' Open on the quote, then the constraint: a Democratic Congress now holds the war purse (see hidden constraint). Proven set: Iran/Gulf confrontation + Trump-Iran endgame.
sections.context: Background: IN-WINDOW (AJ liveblog 11:05 + 11:10 GMT = 15:05 + 15:10 ; Reuters wire Nov 4): Khamenei Nov 4 message — broader retaliation if US attacks again; US hostility unchanged by midterms

totw_analysis: Our read: LEAD Short: 'Khamenei's Nov 4 warning — after losing Congress, Trump faces a wider war if he strikes again.' Open on the quote, then the constraint: a Democratic Congress now holds the war purse (see hidden constraint). Proven set: Iran/Gulf confrontation + Trump-Iran endgame. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Deterrence or bluff?
